features.name: Storm Domain Spells
features.description:
| Cleric Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | fog cloud, thunderwave |
| 3rd | gust of wind, shatter |
| 5th | call lightning, sleet storm |
| 7th | control water, ice storm |
| 9th | destructive wave, insect plague |

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor and martial weapons.

features.name: Tempest's Rebuke
features.description: Also at 1st level, when a creature within 5 feet hits you, you can use your reaction to force it to make a DEX save (your spell save DC). Fail: 2d8 damage (lightning or thunder, your choice). Success: half damage. Uses equal to WIS modifier (minimum 1), regained on long rest.

payload.name: Tempest's Rebuke
payload.description: When hit by a creature within 5 ft: DEX save or 2d8 lightning/thunder damage (half on success).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Full Fury
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, when you would deal lightning or thunder damage from an attack, you can use Channel Divinity to deal the maximum possible damage instead of rolling.

features.name: Storm Blast
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, you can choose to push a Large or smaller creature up to 10 feet away from you any time you deal lightning damage to it.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: At 8th level, once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d8 thunder damage. At 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

features.name: Sky's Blessing
features.description: Starting at 17th level, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed whenever you are outdoors.
